subject: Supplier portal invite: claim flow hitting domain ambiguity / account lock
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma@heliotrope.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@heliotrope.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Can't claim vendor invite - keeps creating two accounts

Hi Marissa,

We're stuck on the Zip invite you sent yesterday. When I click the invite link it asks me to sign in, but after authenticating the claim flow presents a choice of 'Organization A' (Heliotrope - vendor) and 'Organization B' (Heliotrope - consumer). If I pick Vendor the flow throws a token error and returns me to the sign-in page. If I pick Consumer it creates a second account under our consumer org.

Attached a screenshot of the error and the onboarding form I filled out. We can't complete PO setup until this is resolved — finance needs the vendor profile to be connected to the tax ID on the form. Can you escalate?

Thanks,
Emma Li
Head of Procurement
Heliotrope Labs
Attachment: error_screenshot.png

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma@heliotrope.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Can't claim vendor invite - keeps creating two accounts

Emma — thanks for the clear repro and screenshots.

Short version: this looks like a domain-normalization edge case in Zip's claim flow where identical org display names with different entity types (vendor vs consumer) are returned and the claimant token is being scoped to the wrong org id, causing a token-validation failure.

Action plan:
- Ben from Ops is looped in to open a cross‑tenant investigation with Zip and to check whether we can reissue an invite scoped explicitly to the vendor entity id.
- Laura in finance will hold on PO issuance until we confirm the vendor profile is properly merged.
- If needed we'll provide the signed onboarding form (attached) and a signed W9 to accelerate vendor proof.

Can you confirm the contact who should receive the reissued invite (same email ok)? Also I attached the form we received for your records.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Attachment: heliotrope_onboarding_form.pdf

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, Emma Li <emma@heliotrope.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Can't claim vendor invite - keeps creating two accounts

Hi all — I dug into the logs and repro steps. Key findings:
- The invite token we issued maps to org_id: 0x7a3b (vendor entity) but Zip's claim API is resolving the claimant's domain to two tenant candidates because of a legacy alias entry.
- When Zip returns multiple candidate tenants they send back a 'choice' payload and we don't currently pin the token to a chosen tenant (we rely on Zip to complete the mapping). If the claimant selects the wrong candidate the token validation fails and the flow resets.

I've opened JIRA-ONBOARD-4123 with Zip Support and attached the sanitized claim_flow_logs.txt showing the token mismatch and timestamps. Next steps I can do from our side:
- Reissue a one-time invite token forcibly scoped to the vendor org id (expires in 24h).
- Provide Zip support the signed onboarding form + tax docs to speed merging the alias.

Emma — would you like the single-use reissue now or do you prefer Zip to fix the alias first? If you need the PO started today we can reissue immediately.

Ben Carter
Platform Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachment: claim_flow_logs.txt

From: Emma Li <emma@heliotrope.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@heliotrope.com
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Can't claim vendor invite - keeps creating two accounts

Thanks Ben — please reissue the single-use invite. Finance needs the vendor profile linked so I can complete the PO. I can also upload the W9 if you need it, happy to send it to a secure link.

If you reissue, please set the expiry to >24h so our legal can verify the profile before acceptance. Also copy procurement@heliotrope.com on the new invite so our admin can accept if I'm pulled into meetings.

—Emma

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma@heliotrope.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Can't claim vendor invite - keeps creating two accounts

Emma — done. I manually generated a vendor-scoped, single-use invite and extended the expiry to 72 hours. Invite sent to emma@heliotrope.com and procurement@heliotrope.com.

Notes for audit:
- JIRA-ONBOARD-4123 opened with Zip (assigned to Zip eng).
- We provided the onboarding form and logged the W9 request. Laura will confirm PO hold/release.

If you still see the token error after using the new link, reply here and we'll flip Zip to a debug mode and run a live session.

Best,
Ben Carter
Platform Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachment: (none)
